m: Fry the curry paste in a splash of oil for 2 minutes until it smells amazing. Add a third of the coconut milk and cook until the oil splits out.
Add the chicken (bite-size) and stir to coat. Cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk with ½ cup water. Add the eggplant in chunks and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the beans for the last 4 minutes. Season with fish sauce and sugar, taste, adjust.
Off the heat, stir through the Thai basil and a squeeze of lime. Serve over rice with sliced chilli.
l: Curry over rice in one container. Squeeze extra lime over when reheating.
g: Naturally gluten free, but check the curry paste and fish sauce labels.
